brief.note: MongoDB joins after its chief left for Meta; the two miners fell again as gold and silver slid.

candidates.name: MongoDB, Inc.
candidates.business: Sells a cloud document database used by developers to build applications
candidates.cause: Chief executive CJ Desai quit without warning to take a senior job at Meta, days before the investor day; founder Dev Ittycheria returns as interim chief.
candidates.right: A permanent chief arrives quickly and Atlas growth continues through the handover
candidates.wrong: The departure signals trouble the guidance has not shown and more executives follow

candidates.name: Kinross Gold Corporation
candidates.business: Mines gold in the Americas and West Africa, from Nevada to Mauritania
candidates.cause: Cut production guidance for 2026 and 2027 by about 8% and raised cost guidance, blaming harsh winter weather and processing problems at the La Coipa mine in Chile.
candidates.right: The weather and processing problems pass and costs per ounce stop climbing
candidates.wrong: Costs keep rising and the lower output persists well beyond next year

candidates.name: Endeavour Silver Corp.
candidates.business: Mines silver and gold in Mexico, Peru and Chile
candidates.cause: Took the main ball mill at its Guanacevi mine offline on 21 September for a three-week trunnion replacement, cutting throughput from 1,100 to 600 tonnes daily.
candidates.right: The mill repair finishes on schedule and Guanacevi throughput returns by mid-October
candidates.wrong: The trunnion damage proves deeper, the outage drags on and guidance is cut
